resources.string: Why this app needs your location

PoGo TXK uses your location to work out which gym or stop you are standing at, so a flare says where you are without you typing it.

The floating bubble collects this in the background — that is the point of it, so you can flare while Pokémon GO is on screen. Location is sent to the PoGo TXK server only when you confirm a flare, and it is never shared with anyone else or used for advertising.

You can skip this. Flares still work; they just will not name a gym.
